Cyan spine: 59-point non-dominated Pareto front | Red dashed cutoff: kappa/kappa0 = 0.06 (chi = 0.427)
Model Summary & Uncalibrated Assumptions
1. Non-Dominated Pareto Front (3 Swept Inputs)
All 59 front points lie continuously on eps_macro,0 = 0.80 edge.
Q_seq max (T=400 C): 28.024 mg/g Cd2+-eq, P=0.19019 mW/cm2
Note: Peak P is flat within 1% across ~563 to 600 C.
2. Permeability Cutoff & Lumen Geometry
Red dashed floor line: Kozeny-Carman kappa/kappa0 = 0.06 at chi = 0.427.
Cell-accessible space: 10-30 um vascular lumens (not <50 nm BET).
d_throat and f_ent are derived deterministically from eps_macro,0.
3. Parameter Basis (All Constants Assumed)
Every parameter curve (BET, pH, CEC, R_char, f_QS) is hand-set.
No parameters are fitted yet to experimental biochar or EIS data.
Power P is normalized per projected anode area (mW/cm2).
Q_seq index combines 0.56*CEC (Cd2+-eq, high 48 cmol/kg at 400 C)
with an assumed biogenic EPS contribution.
4. Literature Tension to Test Experimentally
The interior ~584 C peak arises solely from the f_QS high-T penalty.
Published biochar anodes often plateau at 800-1000 C, and short
assays report higher initial attachment on hotter chars. Microfluidic
imaging across 450/620/780 C (+AHL add-back) directly tests this gap.
ElectroBioCore v0.1.0 | Scale: P_max = 0.2473 mW/cm2 | Q_max = 28.02 mg/g
